id: # Columns, the `on` grammar and driver keys: vault/architecture/guard-file-formats.md and
# This repo is bash and markdown: no container, no vendor folder and no suite that costs minutes.
# comment-density runs on every commit and on pushes to release branches, as the v1 `both` scope did.
# doc-lint runs on commits only: the driver measures the gate's staged-tree copy and refuses any other tree.
# rule-count is deliberately absent: bin/rule-count.sh --assert already exits 1 on main, so a row
# for it would refuse every push from the day it was written.

args: parser=cloc artifact=quality-reports/cloc.json -- mkdir -p quality-reports && cloc --json --quiet bin lib templates > quality-reports/cloc.json
why: the engine scripts keep their comments as they grow, because a reader of bash needs the reason beside the code
changed documents follow the document standard, so a later reader can act on them
